name: Agent Passport System
description: Agent Passport System trust verification provider for OpenClaw. Reference implementation of Agent Trust Verification Provider Pattern v0.1. Intended to gate skill installs and high-risk tool calls and to expose APS primitives via OpenClaw gateway RPC. Known issue: versions through 0.2.1 do not register successfully with current OpenClaw; see the repository README.

provider.description: Provider name. Always 'aps' for this plugin.

verifier.description: Public APS trust profile API base URL.

jwks.description: APS gateway JWKS endpoint for envelope signature verification.

passportPath.description: Local APS passport file path. Read only when signing.enabled is true; otherwise install and tool gates work and the private key is never loaded.

signing.description: Controls for the aps.signMessage gateway method.

enabled.description: Turn on aps.signMessage. Leaving this false is the safe default: when it is true, any plugin or gateway client allowed below can have arbitrary messages signed with the configured passport private key.

allowedCallers.description: Callers permitted to sign: OpenClaw plugin ids, or the literal 'gateway-client' for any authenticated gateway client the host did not name as a plugin. Empty means no caller may sign.

requireApproval.description: Require an explicit decision on every signing request. OpenClaw 2026.9.2 gives a gateway RPC handler no approval channel, so leaving this true means signing requests are refused rather than signed unattended.

auditLogPath.description: Local JSON Lines log of every signing request and refusal, recording caller, domain prefix and message digest, never the message body.

warnBelow.description: Surface a warning finding when author APS grade is below this value.

blockBelow.description: Block install when author APS grade is below this value. null disables blocking.

highRiskTools.description: Tool names treated as high-risk. Default: bash, exec, fetch.

delegation.description: Trust inputs for authority-aware delegation verification. Supplied by the operator and never read from the record being verified.

trustedIssuers.description: Issuers this operator trusts, each with the Ed25519 public key it signs with. Empty means nothing verifies.

allowSelfSignedRoot.description: Accept a root whose issuer and subject are the same identity. Integrity-only; not a substitute for issuer trust, and the issuer must still resolve to a configured key.
